title: 151. Quantitative Relationships & Measurement: Present Value of a Single Future Payment
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.concept: Present Value of a Single Future Payment
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the present value of a future payment using annual compounding.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(1100\text{ yuan}\) due in \(1\) year at \(10\%\) annual interest?
questions.explanation:
Use the present value formula \(PV=\frac{FV}{(1+r)^n}\). Here \(FV=1100\), \(r=0.10\), and \(n=1\). Thus
\[
PV=\frac{1100}{1.10}=1000
\]
Therefore, the present value is \(1000\text{ yuan}\). Option A is the future payment itself, not its present value.

questions.concept: Present Value of a Future Payment over Two Years
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the present value of a future payment using annual compounding over two years.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(1210\text{ yuan}\) due in \(2\) years at \(10\%\) annual interest?
questions.explanation:
Using \(PV=\frac{FV}{(1+r)^n}\) with \(FV=1210\), \(r=0.10\), and \(n=2\),
\[
PV=\frac{1210}{(1.10)^2}=\frac{1210}{1.21}=1000
\]
Therefore, the present value is \(1000\text{ yuan}\). Option A is not consistent with two years of compounding.
questions.hint: Compute \((1.10)^2\) first, then divide the future payment by it.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the present value of a payment due in three years at \(8\%\) annual interest.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(5000\text{ yuan}\) due in \(3\) years at \(8\%\) annual interest?
questions.explanation:
Using \(PV=\frac{FV}{(1+r)^n}\) with \(FV=5000\), \(r=0.08\), and \(n=3\),
\[
PV=\frac{5000}{(1.08)^3}=\frac{5000}{1.259712}\approx3969.16
\]
Therefore, the present value is approximately \(3969.16\text{ yuan}\). Option B is not consistent with annual compounding.
questions.hint: Compute \((1.08)^3\), then divide \(5000\) by the result.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate present value when interest is compounded semiannually.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(8000\text{ yuan}\) due in \(4\) years at \(5\%\) annual interest compounded semiannually?
questions.explanation:
Use \(PV=\frac{FV}{\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}}\) with \(FV=8000\), \(r=0.05\), \(n=2\), and \(t=4\). Then
\[
PV=\frac{8000}{(1.025)^8}\approx\frac{8000}{1.2184029}\approx6565.97
\]
Therefore, the present value is approximately \(6565.97\text{ yuan}\). Option A is not consistent with semiannual compounding.
questions.hint: Use \(n=2\) and \(nt=8\) in the present value formula.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the present value of a payment due in five years at \(6\%\) annual interest.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(10{,}000\text{ yuan}\) due in \(5\) years at \(6\%\) annual interest?
questions.explanation:
Using \(PV=\frac{FV}{(1+r)^n}\) with \(FV=10{,}000\), \(r=0.06\), and \(n=5\),
\[
PV=\frac{10{,}000}{(1.06)^5}\approx\frac{10{,}000}{1.3382256}\approx7472.58
\]
Therefore, the present value is approximately \(7472.58\text{ yuan}\). Option A is not consistent with the given rate and time.
questions.hint: Compute \((1.06)^5\) first, then divide \(10{,}000\) by it.

questions.concept: Finding the Interest Rate from Present and Future Values
questions.learningObjective: Determine the annual interest rate when present value, future value, and time are known.
questions.question: A future payment of \(1331\text{ yuan}\) due in \(3\) years has a present value of \(1000\text{ yuan}\). What is the annual interest rate?
questions.explanation:
Using \(PV=\frac{FV}{(1+r)^n}\), we have
\[
1000=\frac{1331}{(1+r)^3}
\]
Thus \((1+r)^3=\frac{1331}{1000}=1.331\). Since \(1.10^3=1.331\), \(1+r=1.10\), so \(r=0.10=10\%\). Therefore, the annual interest rate is \(10\%\). Option B does not match the given values.
questions.hint: Set up the present value equation and take the cube root of \(1.331\).

questions.concept: Finding Time from Present and Future Values
questions.learningObjective: Determine the time required for a present value to grow to a given future value.
questions.question: A present value of \(500\text{ yuan}\) grows to \(665.50\text{ yuan}\) at \(10\%\) annual interest. How many years are needed?
questions.explanation:
Using \(FV=PV(1+r)^n\), we have
\[
665.50=500(1.10)^n
\]
Thus \((1.10)^n=\frac{665.50}{500}=1.331\). Since \(1.10^3=1.331\), \(n=3\). Therefore, \(3\) years are needed. Option A is too short because \(1.10^2=1.21\).
questions.hint: Divide the future value by the present value, then compare with powers of \(1.10\).

questions.learningObjective: Calculate present value when interest is compounded quarterly.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(2000\text{ yuan}\) due in \(18\) months at \(8\%\) annual interest compounded quarterly?
questions.explanation:
The time is \(t=1.5\) years, and \(n=4\), so \(nt=4\times1.5=6\). Using
\[
PV=\frac{FV}{\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}}
\]
with \(FV=2000\), \(r=0.08\), and \(n=4\),
\[
PV=\frac{2000}{(1.02)^6}\approx\frac{2000}{1.1261624}\approx1775.94
\]
Therefore, the present value is approximately \(1775.94\text{ yuan}\). Option A is not consistent with quarterly compounding.
questions.hint: Convert \(18\) months to \(1.5\) years, then use \(n=4\) and \(nt=6\).

questions.learningObjective: Calculate present value when interest is compounded monthly.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(5000\text{ yuan}\) due in \(2\) years at \(12\%\) annual interest compounded monthly?
questions.explanation:
Here \(r=0.12\), \(n=12\), and \(t=2\), so \(nt=24\) and \(\frac{r}{n}=0.01\). Using
\[
\begin{aligned}
PV &= \frac{FV}{\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}}\\
PV &= \frac{5000}{(1.01)^{24}}\approx\frac{5000}{1.2697346}\approx3937.83
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the present value is approximately \(3937.83\text{ yuan}\). Option A is not consistent with monthly compounding.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate present value when interest is compounded semiannually over three years.
questions.question: What is the present value of \(10{,}000\text{ yuan}\) due in \(3\) years at \(8\%\) annual interest compounded semiannually?
questions.explanation:
Here \(r=0.08\), \(n=2\), and \(t=3\), so \(nt=6\) and \(\frac{r}{n}=0.04\). Using
\[
\begin{aligned}
PV &= \frac{FV}{\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}}\\
PV &= \frac{10{,}000}{(1.04)^6}\approx\frac{10{,}000}{1.2653190}\approx7903.15
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the present value is approximately \(7903.15\text{ yuan}\). Option B is not consistent with semiannual compounding.
